summary: Lucas GC Limited, a Nasdaq-listed AI-driven PaaS company incorporated in the Cayman Islands, filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing 1H 2026 financial results. Revenue for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was RMB245.3 million (US$35.7 million), down 36.6% year-over-year, while gross margin rose 1.7 points to 35.4% and net income fell 7.6% to RMB19.9 million. No transaction, corporate action, board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. Watch for operational execution amid the strategic pivot and macro headwinds in China.
